item.grappin.grappin.aide1: Right click: throws the hook (30 blocks); it only holds on an anchor point
item.grappin.grappin.aide2: Once hooked, you are pulled straight to the aimed point, then the hook lets go; a click releases and throws again
item.grappin.grappin.aide3: Space or sneak: let go on the way (Space keeps your momentum and jumps)
item.grappin.cape_lestee.aide2: Underwater, moving forward: fast swim where you look (sprint = faster)
item.grappin.cape_lestee.aide3: Weight key (V by default): sink, then walk, jump and mine on the bottom like on land; press again to rise
item.grappin.cape_lestee.aide4: While fast swimming, left click: whirlpool attack around you
item.grappin.paravoile.aide1: In your hand (main or off hand): jump in mid-air to open the glider and glide
item.grappin.paravoile.aide2: Your view steers: look down to dive, look up to brake; jump or sneak to stow it
item.grappin.paravoile.aide3: %s s of flight, gauge recharged in %s s on the ground
entity.grappin.golem.phase2: The Root Guardian unleashes its fury!
